subject: Implementation of hierarchical model in Nimble and Winbugs

messages.author: 4b31e1109581a8a9
messages.subject: Implementation of hierarchical model in Nimble and Winbugs
parts:
Hi,

Have any of you in the list converted WinBUGS model to NIMBLE and
compared results.

I had implemented a hierarchical spatial (CAR) model with and without
indicator variables in WinBUGS and I am facing problems when I run the
same model in NIMBLE.

The posterior distributions of parameters for the model WITHOUT
indicator variables are very similar between WinBUGS and NIMBLE.
However, the model WITH indicator variables seems to have problem when
implemented in NIMBLE. The posterior summaries of indicator variables,
as well as the MC errors, obtained in NIMBLE are quite different from
WinBUGS estimates. I have used these binary indicator variables to
assess the relative importance of predictor variables, following the
modelling structure suggested by Kuo and Mallick 1998. The WinBUGS
results of the indicator variables make ecological sense, while Nimble
doesn't.

I was wondering why the inclusion of indicator variables should yield
such drastically different results between WinBUGS and Nimble.

I would greatly appreciate any insights and pointers.
